title: Jazz and the Art of Listening
short_teaser: Jazz improvisation is not simply playing whatever comes to mind.
story: Jazz improvisation is not simply playing whatever comes to mind. Musicians listen closely, respond to one another, work within structure, and build on what has already been offered. Creativity can be a conversation in which attention matters as much as originality. Creativity is not reserved for rare bursts of inspiration. It grows through attention, experimentation, revision, and the courage to make an imperfect beginning. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
